top_signals.title: Goldman’s Mericle Says December Hike Looms
top_signals.summary: Economists expect the Federal Reserve to hold interest rates steady while keeping the door open to a December move. Goldman Sachs Chief US Economist David Mericle discusses the economic outlook ahead of the Fed’s October decision on Bloomberg Open Interest. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Israel’s Arabs seek a slice of power
top_signals.summary: Arab parties are eyeing a record number of Knesset seats and potential kingmaker role after a surge in Palestinian Israeli votes
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
